The atom at zero matters: P(0)=(2^r+1)^2/2^(2r+2) while for t>=1 P(t)=S_t(2^(r+1)-S_(t+1))/2^(2r+2). Subtraction gives the single-crossing sign S_(t+1)/2^(r+1)-(t+1)/(r+1). Comparing t=1 and t=0 gives exact numerator 2^r(r-2)-r-2, positive for r>=3; boundary r=1,2 favors ex-ante fairness. Binomial tails imply t_r/r->1/2.
